en-us.Kanon_Opt_AcceptOffer_NotInOffice: "This isn't the place to talk business. We'll discuss that matter at the office."
en-us.Kanon_Opt_AcceptOffer_Open:
Kanon sets down the documents in her hand and looks up at $self.name$.
"What, changed your mind? The terms from that night haven't changed — you shoot the films, we sell them, and that money pays off the debt."
"Sit. First, let me make clear what I'll be asking of you."
en-us.Kanon_Opt_AcceptOffer_Option1:
"That's the whole of it."
Kanon's gaze fixes on $self.name$'s face.
"So — will you do it, or not?"
en-us.Kanon_Opt_AcceptOffer_Refuse: "Suit yourself. If you change your mind, just come by anytime."
